Eligibility of Tenderer : This invitation for Tender is open to Enlisted ( Electrical) Contractor of Rajuk or Other Govt./ Semi Govt./ Autonomous
Organization/ Reputed Bonafied Firm as mentioned below as further detailed in the Tender Data Sheet (TDS) as well as
Particular Conditions of Contract (PCC) of the Tender Document.
(a) The Tenderer having minimum 05 ( Five) years general experience of electro--mechanical works .
(b)The Tenderer shall have successefully completed of 1 (One) No. Solar LED Street Light / LED Street Light/LED
Light/Security Light or External Electrification works of amounts at least Tk 50.00 (Fifty) lac under a single
contract(s) over a period of 05 (Five) years under Govt./Semi Govt./Autonomous Organization/Reputed Bonafied Firm. In
case of experience in Bonafied Firm, certificate should have to be vetted by the concern circle/division of Public Works
Department (PWD). Years counting backward from the date of publication of IFT in the newspaper/Website.
(c) The minimum amount of Liquid Assets or Working Capital or Credit facilities of the Tenderer shall be Tk. 55.00 (Fifty
five) Lac only.
(d) Annual Electro - Mechanical Turnover : Last five years ( Financial year 2018-2019, 2019-2020 , 2020-2021, 2021-2022,
2022-2023 ) average Annual Turnover should be required minimum amount Tk.40.00 (Forty) Lac.
(e) Tenderer must have up-to-date ABC Category Contractory & Electrical Supervisory License from Bangladesh
Electrical Licensing Board.
(f) The Tenderer must have Income Tax clearance Certificate (2021-2022).
(g) The Tenderer must have VAT/BIN Registration Certificate.
(h) The Tenderer must have valid Trade License (2022-2023)
